Unfortunately, I can't reproduce this error message on my side. My guess is that 1) the data was not read correctly in 'raw'. or 2) the output of Progenesis might have different column or came from different output. I recommend to check your output has the same columns as in manual (for Progenesis part)

Hope to help.

Best,

messages.author: df9ba0266a9a081f
messages.subject: Re: output from prognosis generate errs
parts:
It was due to different format of data / column names of data.
From v 3.10.2, ProgenesistoMSstatsFormat function is updated for handling little different format or columns. 
However, first two rows should look like example data in page 25 of MSstats_v3.7.3_manual.pdf
Please check your input before using converter function.

- Meena
